Thanks for the heads-up, Aisha — and thanks for offering to join remotely. Marissa, Ben — quick proposal so we don't lose interviewer time:

Options (pick one):
1) Start on time at 9:00 with Ben running a condensed 30-min design/codewalk, and have Marissa review the recording and do a 30-min follow-up later today if needed.
2) Delay start until Aisha joins and keep Marissa as primary (if Marissa can shift).
3) Convert today's session to a 45-min recorded codewalk with notes; Marissa will review and give feedback asynchronously.

If Ben is available to take the 9:00 slot, we'll update the calendar and record the session (Aisha: we'll send the Zoom link now). If Marissa prefers option 2 or 3, say so and we'll reschedule.

Ben: are you available to start at 9:00 and run a condensed session? If yes I'll update the invite and enable recording.

Aisha: we'll send the Zoom link shortly. If you prefer to wait in traffic and join in-person that is totally fine — we just want to be respectful of everyone's time.
